name: par_yield_bootstrap_forward_and_offpar_price_para
question_template:
Par yields on annual-coupon bonds are quoted for maturities of one, two and three years: {Y1} percent, {Y2} percent and {Y3} percent. The par yield is defined as the coupon rate (as a percent of face) at which a bond paying that coupon at each year end, together with face at maturity, is priced at exactly face value when each cash flow is discounted using the zero curve. The zero rates are effective annual rates, so a cash flow at year t is discounted by (1 + z_t)^t, and the three zero rates are the unique set consistent with all three par yields (bootstrapped starting from the shortest maturity). The one-year forward rate beginning in two years is the rate f satisfying (1 + z_2)^2 (1 + f) = (1 + z_3)^3.

Consider a different three-year bond with face USD {FACE}. It pays a coupon at each year end at a rate equal to the three-year par yield plus {SPREAD_BP} basis points (a basis point is 0.01 percentage point); should that sum be negative, the coupon rate is taken to be zero. The face is returned along with the final coupon. Value the bond by discounting every cash flow at the bootstrapped zero rates. Give the two-year zero rate, the three-year zero rate and the forward rate in percent, and the bond price in USD.

slots.description: Bootstrapped effective annual two-year zero rate in percent
Bootstrapped effective annual three-year zero rate in percent
One-year forward rate starting in two years, in percent

program:
def nth_root(x, n):
    from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
    getcontext().prec = 60
    d = Decimal(x.numerator) / Decimal(x.denominator)
    return d ** (Decimal(1) / Decimal(n))

def solve():
    y1 = Q(P["Y1"]) / 100
    y2 = Q(P["Y2"]) / 100
    y3 = Q(P["Y3"]) / 100
    face = Q(P["FACE"])
    spread = Q(P["SPREAD_BP"]) / 10000
    c = y3 + spread
    if c < 0:
        c = Q(0)
    d1 = 1 / (1 + y1)
    d2 = (1 - y2 * d1) / (1 + y2)
    if d2 <= 0:
        raise ValueError("two-year discount factor not positive")
    d3 = (1 - y3 * (d1 + d2)) / (1 + y3)
    if d3 <= 0:
        raise ValueError("three-year discount factor not positive")
    z2 = (1 / nth_root(d2, 2) - 1) * 100
    z3 = (1 / nth_root(d3, 3) - 1) * 100
    fwd = (d2 / d3 - 1) * 100
    price = face * (c * (d1 + d2 + d3) + d3)
    return {"final": price, "two_year_zero_rate": z2, "three_year_zero_rate": z3, "forward_rate_2y1y": fwd}
